legal.draftNotice: Draft. This text will be reviewed before the app opens to the public.

privacySections.title: What we store
privacySections.body: Your email address (for signing in), your profile, the days you read, your reading plans and progress, your highlights, bookmarks and notes, and what you post, react to and comment on. Notes, highlights and plan reflections are private: only you can see them, unless you choose to share a reflection as a post.

privacySections.title: Who sees your posts
privacySections.body: Your profile setting decides it: public (anyone signed in), friends (people you accept), or private (only you). Blocking someone hides your profile and posts from them. When someone reports content, moderators can see the reported content.

privacySections.title: Where it is stored
privacySections.body: On Supabase servers in Zurich, Switzerland. The Bible text is served from our website host.

privacySections.title: What we never do
privacySections.body: We show no ads, sell no data and use no tracking for advertising.

privacySections.title: Notifications
privacySections.body: If you allow notifications, your browser gives us an address to send reminders to. You can turn reminders off or remove permission at any time.

privacySections.title: Your rights
privacySections.body: In Settings you can download all your data or delete your account permanently. Deleting your account removes everything linked to it.

privacySections.title: Contact
privacySections.body: Questions about privacy: the contact address will be added here before launch.

termsSections.title: Free to use
termsSections.body: The app is free. There are no ads and no paid features.

termsSections.title: Who can use it
termsSections.body: You need to be 13 or older to create an account.

termsSections.title: Bible text
termsSections.body: The Berean Standard Bible and the World English Bible are in the public domain.

termsSections.title: Being kind
termsSections.body: The community guidelines apply to everything you post. Content that breaks them can be removed, and accounts that break them repeatedly can be suspended.

termsSections.title: Changes
termsSections.body: If these terms change, we’ll tell you in the app before the change takes effect.

legal.guidelinesIntro: DailyBread is a place to read the Bible together and encourage each other. These guidelines apply to everything you post.

guidelinesSections.title: Be kind
guidelinesSections.body: Encourage, don't attack. Disagree with ideas respectfully and never with insults. Christians read the Bible in different traditions; welcome that.

guidelinesSections.title: Keep it about reading and prayer
guidelinesSections.body: Share verses, reflections, prayer requests and milestones. No advertising, fundraising, spam or links.

guidelinesSections.title: Keep people safe
guidelinesSections.body: No harassment, threats, hate, sexual content or content that endangers anyone. Many readers are teenagers: post only what is right for them to see.

guidelinesSections.title: Respect privacy
guidelinesSections.body: Don't share other people's private information or prayer requests without their permission.

guidelinesSections.title: If something is wrong
guidelinesSections.body: Use Report on any post, comment or profile. Reports are private. You can also mute or block anyone at any time.

guidelinesSections.title: What happens next
guidelinesSections.body: Moderators review reports. Content that breaks these guidelines is removed, and accounts that break them repeatedly can be suspended.
